versions.changelog:
- Major update: Replaced coding workflow guidance with a comprehensive code review assistant.
- Removed all prior workflow files (planning, execution, verification, memory, etc.).
- New features: code quality analysis, security/performance/coding-style review, bug detection, documentation and test coverage checks.
- Added language-specific review guidelines and common anti-patterns.
- Included review templates and practical examples for actionable feedback.
- Updated description and metadata to reflect code review focus.
